leakage_review: IVF_Success is excluded from features. The eight input columns match the existing model metadata; no explicit target-derived column is present. Inspection of generate_ivf_5000.py shows labels are synthetically sampled from probabilities assigned by hand-written feature thresholds. Thus the features are intentionally related to the target, and measured performance reflects recovery of those synthetic rules, not observed IVF outcomes or clinical validity.
